description: Create a discount code. `type` is 'percentage' (value 0-100), 'fixed' (value in minor currency units, requires currency e.g. 'USD'; it applies only to carts in that currency), or 'free_shipping' (value 0). Optional limits: minSubtotal, maxUses, startsAt, endsAt. A cart is in its sales channel's currency; for a 'percentage' or 'free_shipping' code with a minimum, minSubtotal is the default-currency minimum and minSubtotalByCurrency the minimum in each additional currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, required for 'fixed' type, omit otherwise

minSubtotal.description: Minimum cart subtotal in minor units: of the code's own currency for 'fixed', of the default currency otherwise. With minSubtotalByCurrency set, omitting it means the code does not apply to default-currency carts, and 0 means it applies to them with no minimum

minSubtotalByCurrency.description: 'percentage' and 'free_shipping' only: minimum subtotal for carts in each additional currency, e.g. [{currency: 'EUR', amount: 5000}]. A code with any minimum applies only in the currencies its minimums name - nothing is converted

currency.description: One of the workspace's additional currencies (update_cart_config additionalCurrencies)

startsAt.description: ISO date-time the code becomes valid

value.description: Percent (0-100), fixed amount in minor units, or 0

name: create_discount
title: Create discount
